title: 二周目は、俺が決める
reward: 呉天策の無力化と自由に行き来する帰還権

scenes.name: 処刑の続きを終わらせる
scenes.purpose: 第1話の二本指を自分の意思で使う

panels.art: Alliance chief thrusts a narrow GOLD ceremonial blade from right hand at Yun, cracked control crystal in LEFT hand. Yun black sword SHEATHED after turning to protect companions, hands free. No injury.
panels.speaker: 呉天策

panels.art: Large close-up Yun RIGHT index and middle fingers gently STOP chief's gold blade, clearly two fingers, not crushing yet. Yun steady compassionate serious expression contrasts terror from episode 1. Only chief weapon drawn.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun LEFT palm sends a SMALL controlled cyan push into chief's chest, chief safely sits backward onto stair, gold weapon drops beside him. No gore no broken limbs. Yun right fingers release blade safely.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Close Yun picks up fallen cracked black control crystal in left palm and squeezes it into black dust, no blade cutting hands. Chief alive seated, panting. Smith and Hakujin look relieved.
panels.speaker: 白燼

scenes.name: 帰り道を選ぶ
scenes.purpose: 門の条件を解除して帰還を実際に叶える

panels.art: Yun RIGHT hand inserts flat of his one black sword into hidden back groove of gate pedestal. Bronze disk still in FRONT slot, So Rin guides his hand from side, Hakujin watches with hands free. Precision, not a stabbing.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: そこ。刃じゃなく、剣の背を。

panels.art: A thin cyan seam opens around gate, return conditions shatter into harmless light. Translucent CYAN hologram exactly two lines: 真エンド　開放 / 帰還権　獲得. Yun smiles in disbelief.
panels.speaker: システム
panels.text: 真エンド　開放　帰還権　獲得

panels.art: Gate view of his modern student room now clear and accessible. Yun sword SHEATHED at left hip; looks from home to So Rin and Hakujin, tender grateful face.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin and Hakujin at gate wave him off with relief, not clinging. Smith holds ONE worn cloth tool bag as gift offered to Yun's left hand; sword sheathed.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: うん。帰りは、あんたが決めて。

scenes.name: 二つの暮らし
scenes.purpose: 生きて帰る目的を果たし仲間へ自分で戻る

panels.art: Modern student room, Yun still same off-white martial robe dark red sash and sheathed black sword, seated on floor beside desk, exhausted relieved eyes. Cloth tool bag beside him, bronze key on dark red sash recovered after gate opened. Computer and textbooks no printed words. He checks a smartphone without legible screen.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: Yun gently calls home with smartphone to right ear, LEFT hand over mouth emotional but relieved, same outfit. No new modern identity or haircut.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 母さん。今日は、声が聞きたくて。

panels.art: Later Yun returns THROUGH cyan doorway to town forge, still clean same martial outfit, now carries ONE white cloth bundle of bandages and a small packet of tea. Smith at anvil and Hakujin by door warmly surprised.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Final large borderless close view Yun with teal eyes and small confident kind smile, two companions visible behind him at sunlit forge, sword sheathed, no throne no sinister pose.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
